en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Yasser Al Khadim, 
(It has been narrated) from Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Melon upon the empty stomach inherits the stroke. We<sup>asws</sup> seek Refuge with Allah<sup>azwj</sup> from it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Yasar al-Khadim who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
’Eating melons before breakfast causes paralysis, may Allah grant us protection against it!”’
